brief:
Israeli occupation forces announced the launch of a wide-scale military operation in Shufat refugee camp and Anata in occupied East Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. Video footage circulating online documented the beginning of the operation in both locations.

The announcement marked a significant escalation of military activity in the densely populated areas. Shufat camp, home to thousands of Palestinian refugees, and the nearby community of Anata have faced repeated Israeli military incursions. No immediate details were provided regarding the duration, stated objectives, or scale of forces deployed in the operation.
